name: Number of graphs with n vertices that have no induced regular subgraph of order 7 or greater.
comment: a(n) eventually becomes 0. It is known that a(29)>0 but it is not known whether a(30)=0.
link: Paul W. Dyson and Brendan D. McKay, Ramsey numbers for regular induced subgraphs, arXiv:2604.08215 [math.CO] (2026).
Paul Dyson and Brendan McKay, Ramsey Graphs (section Regular induced subgraphs)
S. Fajtlowicz, T. McColgan, T. Reid, and W. Staton, Ramsey numbers for induced regular subgraphs, Ars Combinatoria, 39 (1995) 149-154.
xref: Cf. A394400 (order 4 or greater), A390919 (order 5 or greater), A392636 (order 6 or greater), A394930 (order 7 only).
author: _Brendan McKay_, Apr 07 2026
